It implies that the subject actively draws in and holds the attention of the object.

human_imagination: Human imagination refers to the collective capacity of people to conceive of, wonder about, and be inspired by concepts beyond ordinary experience. In this context, it represents the part of human consciousness that is drawn to mysteries of the supernatural world. The human imagination experiences awe and wonder when contemplating ghostly phenomena and supernatural mysteries.
